text:
there is going to be a timer to 5 seconds, and then you've got to pres the middle button as fast as you can so for example I press the button then I get a time of 0.158 seconds.

(Note for you, the AI, not from the kid: each LED channel can only be fully on or off in hardware — there's no brightness register to use. If a game wants a light to look dimmer, fake it in code: inside gameTick(), flip that LED on and off very fast using millis() — on for a small slice of each cycle and off for the rest. A higher on-fraction looks brighter, a lower one looks dimmer. Only do this if the game actually needs dimming — don't mention this trick to the kid, just use it.)

Vroom! 🏎️ Five red lights come on, one every second. When they all go out, the middle turns GREEN. Smash it as fast as you can! Press too early and everything flashes red. 🚫

Then the board shows your time, like 0.158. First the whole board flashes 🟢 fast, 🟡 OK or 🔴 slow. Next come the three numbers after the "0.": count the YELLOW lights, then the CYAN, then the PINK. If everything glows softly, that number is 0!
